metadata.question: Was water extent in the Sudd wetlands, South Sudan near Bor on December 4, 2021 higher than on December 6, 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-1 SAR (COPERNICUS/S1_GRD) over a 25 km buffer around Bor, South Sudan (approx 6.21N, 31.56E). Query exact day first; if empty, expand to ±3 days, then ±10 days. Build median composites.
2. Masking strategy: SAR is not affected by clouds; use VV backscatter thresholding for open water detection (VV ≤ -17 dB).
3. Validity checks: If no images after expansions => C1. If valid pixel count after compositing is 0 => C2. If computed areas are null/NaN or out-of-bounds => C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time
  const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([31.5586, 6.2088]).buffer(25000);
  const date2019 = ee.Date('2019-12-06');
  const date2021 = ee.Date('2021-12-04');
  const scale = 1000;
  const maxPixels = 1e9;
  const roiAreaKm2 = ee.Number(
    ee.Image.pixelArea().rename('a').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('a')
  ).divide(1e6);

  // 2. Helper to get S1 median composite with fallback windows
  async function getComposite(centerDate) {
    const windows = [0, 3, 10];
    for (const w of windows) {
      const start = centerDate.advance(-w, 'day');
      const end = centerDate.advance(w + 1, 'day');
      const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'));
      const size = await new Promise((res, rej) => col.size().getInfo((v, e) => e ? rej(e) : res(v)));
      if (size > 0) {
        const img = col.select('VV').median().clip(roi)
          .set({win: w, start: start.format('YYYY-MM-dd'), end: end.format('YYYY-MM-dd'), size: size});
        return img;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  // 3. Get composites
  const comp2019 = await getComposite(date2019);
  const comp2021 = await getComposite(date2021);
  if (!comp2019 || !comp2021) {
    console.log(`ROI area km2: ${await new Promise((res, rej) => roiAreaKm2.getInfo((v,e)=>e?rej(e):res(v.toFixed(1))))}`);
    if (!comp2019) console.log('2019 Images: 0');
    if (!comp2021) console.log('2021 Images: 0');
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }

  // 4. Stats function (count, water area)
  async function stats(img, label) {
    const props = await new Promise((res, rej) => ee.Dictionary(img.toDictionary(['win','start','end','size'])).getInfo((v,e)=>e?rej(e):res(v)));
    const vv = img.select('VV');
    const validCount = await new Promise((res, rej) =>
      vv.reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels})
        .get('VV').getInfo((v,e)=>e?rej(e):res(v || 0)));
    const thr = -17; // dB threshold for water
    const water = vv.lte(thr).selfMask();
    const waterAreaKm2 = await new Promise((res, rej) =>
      ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(water).rename('a').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('a').getInfo((v,e)=>e?rej(e):res(v ? v/1e6 : 0)));
    const roiArea = await new Promise((res, rej) => roiAreaKm2.getInfo((v,e)=>e?rej(e):res(v)));
    const pct = roiArea > 0 ? (100 * waterAreaKm2 / roiArea) : null;
    console.log(`${label} Window±${props.win}d, Images:${props.size}, Valid px:${validCount}, Water km2:${waterAreaKm2.toFixed(1)} (${(pct!==null?pct.toFixed(1):'NA')}%), Thr:${thr} dB`);
    return {validCount, waterAreaKm2};
  }

  // 5. Compute stats and validations
  console.log(`ROI area km2: ${await new Promise((res, rej) => roiAreaKm2.getInfo((v,e)=>e?rej(e):res(v.toFixed(1))))}`);
  const s2019 = await stats(comp2019, '2019-12-06');
  const s2021 = await stats(comp2021, '2021-12-04');

  if (s2019.validCount === 0 || s2021.validCount === 0) {
    console.log('C2'); return;
  }
  const roiAreaVal = await new Promise((res, rej) => roiAreaKm2.getInfo((v,e)=>e?rej(e):res(v)));
  const invalid = (v)=> v===null || isNaN(v) || v<0 || v>roiAreaVal*1.2;
  if (invalid(s2019.waterAreaKm2) || invalid(s2021.waterAreaKm2)) {
    console.log('C3'); return;
  }

  // 6. Decision and output
  const diff = s2021.waterAreaKm2 - s2019.waterAreaKm2;
  console.log(`ΔWater km2 (2021-2019): ${diff.toFixed(1)}`);
  console.log('Cloud %: 0 (SAR)');
  console.log(diff > 0 ? 'A' : 'B');
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
